title.narrative: Preparatory Study for Power to Girls: Fase Two

description.narrative: This project aims to prepare us for the next big partnership project. We recently finished a Pilot Project implementing our Power to Girls plans, which we plan to dublicate in our next Partnership Project. The Preparatory study will aim to prepare us for the Partnership Project by compiling feedback and addressing learnings from earlier projects, as well asplanning exactly how we are to implement our new ideas on climate action generated at the Climate Action seminar in Kenya feb. 2024. The Partnership Project will aim to strengthen the activities of the Youth Bonds through a variety of activities on SRHR, advocacy, gender equality, democratic values etc. engaging both the target group and the surrounding community.
